Unofficial NTS Radio player for **Chromecast with Google TV**, **Google TV Streamer** and other Android TV devices. Streams the NTS 1 and NTS 2 live channels and the Infinite Mixtapes, with what's on now and next.

### Install on your Chromecast with Google TV

1. **Turn on developer mode:** Settings → System → About → select *Android TV OS build* 7 times.
2. **Install the free [Downloader](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.esaba.downloader) app** from the Play Store.
3. **Allow it to install apps:** Settings → Apps → Security & restrictions → Unknown sources → turn on *Downloader*.
4. **Open Downloader and enter this address:**
   `https://github.com/barneydobson/nts-tv/releases/latest/download/nts-tv.apk`
   then choose *Install*.

NTS Radio then appears under *Apps* (add it to your Favourites row so it's one click away). Afterwards, turn *Unknown sources* off again for Downloader.

From v1.1.0 the app updates itself when you open it. The first time, press **Allow updates** at the top, switch on NTS Radio, and press Back. If an update ever seems stuck on v1.1.x–1.2.0, switch on Settings → Apps → Security & restrictions → Unknown sources → NTS Radio, force stop the app, and open it again.
